# HMM Unsupervised Classification

Hidden Markov model that learns latent state classes from unlabeled sequences with Baum-Welch EM.

<div class="algorithm-meta">
  <span>Machine Learning</span>
  <span>hmm, unsupervised learning, sequence classification</span>
  <span>Mermaid</span>
</div>

## Flowchart

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Collect unlabeled observation sequences] --> B[Choose number of hidden states]
    B --> C[Initialize transition and emission parameters]
    C --> D[Run forward-backward inference]
    D --> E[Update parameters with Baum-Welch EM]
    E --> F{Converged?}
    F -- No --> D
    F -- Yes --> G[Decode most likely hidden states with Viterbi]
    G --> H[Use hidden states as unsupervised classes]
```

## Formulas

### Joint sequence likelihood

$$
p(x_{1:T}, z_{1:T}) = p(z_1)\prod_{t=2}^{T}p(z_t \mid z_{t-1})\prod_{t=1}^{T}p(x_t \mid z_t)
$$

### EM objective

$$
\theta^{*} = \arg\max_{\theta}\sum_n \log p_{\theta}(x^{(n)}_{1:T_n})
$$

## Notes

- Baum-Welch estimates transition and emission parameters without labeled states.
- Viterbi decoding converts the learned latent states into a discrete class sequence.
